sources.name: FWC red tide / HAB samples
sources.note: Reported samples and sampling dates, not current conditions at every shore. Empty coverage is not a bloom all-clear.

sources.name: FDEP freshwater algal-bloom reports
sources.note: Public sample/report context; verify sample dates and official advisories.

sources.name: Community-reported notable wildlife
sources.note: Community observations, not a complete census or an official operational exclusion zone.

sources.name: FGS reported subsidence
sources.note: Historical reports include unverified events; not a sinkhole-collapse forecast.

sources.name: Florida DOH beach sampling sites
sources.note: The former source currently requires a token. No key is requested. Use current Florida DOH beach advisories at the official public reference; this console does not establish current beach quality.

sources.name: FDEP pollution notices
sources.note: Reported ongoing/ended flag and date remain source assertions; notices are not attributed to a particular station without evidence.

sources.name: Pinellas reported SSO incidents
sources.note: The predecessor public endpoint currently returns a service error (verified23Oct2026). No live records are represented. A working current public source with dates/units is required; this link is retained for source traceability.

sources.name: USF Water Atlas station inventory
sources.note: Station inventory is not current sample quality; retrieve dated results from the responsible source.

sources.name: ORNL ODIN Pinellas outage reports
sources.note: Zero returned records mean unavailable coverage, not zero outages. County aggregates cannot establish station feeder status.

sources.name: NWS heat / wind / precipitation forecast
sources.note: Forecast grid values retain their supplied units and valid times; not worker exposure measurements.

sources.name: NOAA8726520 water temperature
sources.note: Temperature observed at this station in degreesF; not a bay-wide or drinking-water measurement.

sources.name: U.S. Drought Monitor county record
sources.note: County drought map date and class shares are context, not a live drinking-water supply measurement.

sources.name: CDC NWSS wastewater target detections
sources.note: Dated county-serving surveillance records. No individual illness, station pathogen level or drinking-water safety is inferred.

sources.name: NOAA tidal-current predictions
sources.note: Three published current-prediction stations. Forecast velocities are not measured sewer flow or navigation clearance.

sources.name: ASF Sentinel-1 SAR acquisition footprints
sources.note: Acquisition footprint/date only, not ground movement or flood damage. Imagery access and processing are separate.

sources.name: Historical dialysis / nursing-facility reference
sources.note: Original source metadata says May1,2013 licensure snapshot. Not used as a current facility/beds roster or as measured service dependence; a current verified roster is required.

sources.name: USCG NRC reported-spill history
sources.note: Original inline2024–25 initial/unverified reports lack a reproducible retrieval package. They are not copied as current observations; use the official record and verify reporting date/status.

sources.name: NOAA CoastWatch Gulf SST context
sources.note: Original85°F June12,2026 constant is not a current measurement. NOAA station water temperature is available separately; no Gulf-wide SST is invented.

sources.name: NASA/ASF OPERA ground-displacement screening
sources.note: A grayscale tile is not a per-station vertical velocity. Verified raster lineage, projection/LOS interpretation and sampling are required before a numerical asset overlay.

sources.name: FWC manatee protection-zone reference
sources.note: Mapped protection-zone reference; follow current official restrictions, not the coordinate plot.

sources.name: NOAA/USCG navigation-aid reference
sources.note: Published navigation context only. This console is not a navigational chart or route-clearance authority.

sources.name: Hydro · SWFWMD Surface-water level (last record)
sources.note: Source level retains units, vertical datum and timestamp; not interchangeable with MLLW or surveyed asset heights. Service operates6AM–10PM daily and is not survey certified.
